name: Uri Jip Bangguseogui Yongnim
source:
"I am the great dragon, Jin Hana, who travels through different worlds!"
One day, an ordinary job seeker, "I," is suddenly visited by Hana, a young dragon girl from another world.
A heartwarming visual novel about living with an adorable dragon.
